line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.2: Mission cleanup is now handled here rather than in Mayhem.Mission.Fail.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Added extra cleanup for additional missions besides rescue and police.
* Police: destroy passenger. Remove the local variables from the suspects and culprit.
* Unlike failing the other ship reward missions, the culprit is not destroyed because it is a real worker.
* Suppression: clear pending or active target state if the target survives.
* Delivery: clear mission state from the delivery ship.
* Only if the mission was not completed.
* Rescue: JOO the ship if it's not [PLAYERSHIP] and ship belongs to the player.
* NPCs will instead recycle the ship.
* Delivery: If a destination station was destroyed, the surviving delivery ship is allowed to remain as consolation.
* Otherwise, remove it unless it is the PLAYERSHIP. The PLAYERSHIP is never destroyed during mission cleanup.
* Patrol: JOO all spawned Xenon ships.
* Bait: JOO the bait ship if it's not [PLAYERSHIP] and ship belongs to the player.
* NPCs will instead recycle the ship, Also JOO all spawned Kha'ak ships.
* Defense: JOO all spawned Xenon ships.
